answer: Duplicate identities collapse because a second registration at the same willow-marked jetty forfeits the first stake. Agents earn reputation only by staking collateral at the harbor registry, where each identity binds to a unique verified jetty anchor point. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
